_comment: icraft #35 Cataclysm boss-only Tetra material (refight-to-repair) -- T4 / End peak. REPAIR ITEM = cataclysm:gauntlet_of_guard, the signature drop of the Ender Guardian (ruined_citadel, End, T4). Cataclysm gives the Ender Guardian NO native ingot, so the repair binds directly to the unique gauntlet drop -- the PUREST refight-to-repair: one Guardian kill yields one gauntlet, i.e. one repair. FLAG: this consumes a usable gauntlet weapon and is deliberately punishing; the alternative is minting a dedicated ender_guard_plating drop item (see report). Highest stats of the boss-material set, befitting the End tier; LOW durability (1300) keeps the refight loop alive. Tools + armor.
